raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Starting with batch 3, the source has been delivering part of each batch with a delay of about 3 days. For example, batch 11 ingested on 2026-01-16 contains transactions from 2026-01-13. The silver step's lateness filter (ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 hours) silently drops these valid, unique POSTED transactions. Because silver and gold are fully rebuilt from all raw data on each run and gold is grouped by txn_date, keeping late-arriving rows is correct, and batches 1-2 show the monitor only expects REVERSED rows to be excluded.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.68, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
